request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Summary**", "2": "We tested four interaction-themed features, and none is convincing.", "3": "One failure: multiplying cross-sectional ranks of three-month hourly-pay momentum and hours momentum gave a slightly negative, insignificant information coefficient.", "4": "Contrasting three-month changes in two flow rates produced essentially zero signal.", "5": "Persistence of rising hours, restricted to high common-index regimes, was slightly negative and had reduced coverage.", "6": "The most informative feature was the stock rate standardized against its own expanding history, interacted with the common index.", "7": "It was weakly positive overall but sharply regime-dependent: positive when the index was low and strongly negative when it was high.", "8": "It also overlapped moderately with an existing base signal.", "9": "A suggested next step is to isolate that stock-rate signal within low-index regimes."}, "hypothesis": "Composition reversal: groups whose V06 stock is unusually high relative to their smoothed V04 flow, versus own history, earn higher next-month relative returns, mainly in high common-index periods, mirroring submission 2's strongly negative high-index IC.", "expression": "tsz(ratio(V06, mavg(V04,3)), \"exp\")"}
